title: The Reason Why Data Center GPUs Have Such Short Lifespans - BGR
summary: However, even GPUs with a lower utilization rate will only last for a maximum of five years in a data center. Notably, the latest "gigawatt data centers" are equipped with hundreds of thousands of GPUs.
